task: perf item 4: changepoint-detector first press waited on its worker's module revalidation chain
errors: A scratchpad Playwright script failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: ESM import 'playwright' does not resolve outside a project; fixed with createRequire (or NODE_PATH=/opt/node-tools/node_modules for the venture's eval scripts).
marisstella.app is 403 through the agent proxy, so live-site headers came from docs/reports/2026-11-07-live-site-measurements.md, not a fresh probe.

doc_friction.issue: Item 4 points at page weight (module-weight.mjs), but this page's real cost was a worker revalidation chain that weight sweeps can't see. A line on workers missing modulepreload, and on max-age=0 chains, would have saved the first ~15 minutes.
Their headers say 'needs the playwright package', but a bare `node eval/x.mjs` fails in the cloud container until NODE_PATH=/opt/node-tools/node_modules is set; cloud-session.md doesn't mention it.

deviations.why: The prompt suggests measuring throttled bandwidth and CPU via CDP. I put the delay in the server instead (150 ms per request) because CDP network emulation may not cover dedicated-worker fetches, and the cost under study was a request waterfall.
deviations.result: the waterfall reproduced deterministically (30 304s, 1,355 ms); the second press is the in-page floor

goal: faster first result for visitors of a tool page
notes: Metric: time from the first 'Load example' press to the result and to the finished agreed panel. Set-up: built page (build.mjs --only=changepoint-detector) served by platform/perf/revalidate-serve.mjs (public, max-age=0, must-revalidate + ETag, gzip, 150 ms per request), headless Chromium, fresh context, 3 s idle after load; node ventures/changepoint-detector/eval/first-press-browser.mjs <url> 7, median of 7. Before (c4e749c19): result 1,355 ms, panel 1,887 ms, 30 requests after the press (all 304). After: result 98 ms, panel 870 ms, 8 requests. Second press 92/226 before, 78/173 after. Same answers: innerHTML of the result panels, agreed and error identical between builds on the Nile, Prop 99 and FX examples. Fallback: worker files 404 still give the result and panel. eval agreed/analyze/columns worker browser checks ok. run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector: 1,149 pass (253 s). CI: see PR.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior front-end engineer: reproduce live caching locally, find the worker preload gap, fix, verify same output, write up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
